labels.why: The row only decides how the requested endpoint behaviour works: "GET /users gains a `role` filter: `role=<role>` keeps only the users with that role", "in every user GET /users answers, whether as an array or in the items of a page", and "A `role` that is none of the three roles, an empty one included, answers HTTP 400".

labels.label: requested
labels.why: Reusing the existing user store to hold each user's role is how the request is met: "Every user has a `role`, which is `admin`, `member` or `viewer`: Ada Lovelace is an admin, Grace Hopper a member and Alan Turing a viewer".
